props.name: children
props.description: The words to mark. Keep it to a short phrase — the mark does not wrap across lines.

props.name: variant
props.description: Underline, a highlighter swipe behind the words, a loose circle, or a box.

props.name: tint
props.description: Strength of the accent, 0–100. The highlighter defaults lighter so the words stay readable.

props.name: animate
props.description: Draw the mark in when it scrolls into view. False draws it straight away.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the pen takes, in ms.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before drawing, in ms — to follow a heading's own entrance.
